university.name: University of the Philippines Open University
university.location: Maahas, Los Baños, Laguna (nationwide open and distance learning)
university.description: UP System constituent and the Philippines' pioneer in open, distance, and online learning (ODeL), headquartered in Los Baños. Delivers undergraduate and graduate degrees nationwide through distance education, MOOCs, continuing education, and microcredentials under RA 10650 (Open Distance Learning Law).
university.tuition: Free under RA 10931 for eligible UP System students; socialized tuition and fees apply for others (verify on official UPOU site)
